title.zh-cn: 赛博办公 IM 分身

description.en: Open-source cyber office IM stand-in for DSH: watch Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk, start duty in place by @-ing yourself with a keyword, and wake the agent only when needed to handle chats as you — silent by default, speaking only with new information. Message bodies stay local.
description.zh-cn: 开源赛博办公 IM 分身：在 DSH 里替你值守飞书 / 企业微信 / 钉钉，@ 自己 + 关键词就地开值班，需要你时才唤醒 agent、默认沉默、有增量才开口；消息正文只留本机。

description.en: Sidebar stand-in for Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk: wakes the agent only when a chat needs attention, then lets it research and reply in your voice. Silent by default — it speaks only with new information or a clear human question, and never commits you to meetings, signatures or payments. Watch-level control, automatic triage for new groups, per-seat draft/auto send mode, self-@ keywords that start duty in place with a configurable reply, quoted-message context, recall-on-send progress cards (opt-in for groups), searchable/filterable service targets, 7-day idle retirement and 2-day task wrap-up — with local-first message bodies.
description.zh-cn: 在 DSH 侧边栏常驻的赛博办公 IM 分身：盯飞书 / 企业微信 / 钉钉的私聊与群聊，命中 @我 或新消息才唤醒 agent，由它查证、调研并按你的语气回复；默认沉默，有增量或本人明确在问才开口，参会 / 签字 / 付款这类本人到场的事只提醒不代答；支持关注程度三态、新群自动分诊、按值班单点切换草稿审批 / 全自动发送；在 IM 里 @ 自己 + 关键词就地开值班并回一条可配回执；连续 7 天没命中自动退役，任务完成后观察 2 天再退；引用消息带被引用原文、进度卡发信即撤回（群聊可单独开）、群聊 / 人物档案可搜索筛选。消息正文只在本机，复用本机 IM CLI 登录态。
